snippet.title: Sleepover: reWake Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
#SleepoverreWake #Sleepover #blits 

A heartfelt remake of the classic Visual Novel! Now available for purchase on the BLits Website, Steam and Itch.io - get your copy at the links below:

https://www.blitsgames.com/product/sleepover/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3961110/Sleepover_reWake/?utm_source=youtube

https://blitsgames.itch.io/sleepover

Sleepover: reWake is a full remaster of the classic visual novel, Sleepover. It features the short story of Kano and Aki, two best friends who have drifted apart of the years. Through a twist of fate, the two are offered an opportunity to reconnect, and take the chance with each other that they never could before! Help Kano navigate the two's changed relationship, and create a special bond with Aki to last forever.

One Night is all it takes!

FOLLOW US!
▷Official Website : https://blitsgames.com
▷Official Twitter : https://twitter.com/blitsblgames
